# optimizelycmp_users (Data Source)

Every user in the organisation, with their roles. Use optimizelycmp_user to find one by email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_users" "all" {}

# Everyone with the Creator role.
output "creators" {
  value = [for u in data.optimizelycmp_users.all.users : u.full_name if contains(u.roles, "Creator")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "users"; present because every data source needs an ID.
- `users` (Attributes List) The users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `first_name` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `last_name` (String)
- `roles` (List of String) Role names.
